up.note: $\mathrm{UC}_{\min} = \min\{\mathrm{UC}^0,\mathrm{UC}^1\}$ and $\mathrm{UC} = \max\{\mathrm{UC}^0,\mathrm{UC}^1\}$ [BHT17, Sec. 2.5]: the cheaper side is at most the dearer one. As with $\mathrm{C}^0$, this is the line that gives the row an upper bound of any kind -- the other recorded $\mathrm{UC}_{\min}$ facts, $\mathrm{D} \le \mathrm{UC}_{\min}^2$ and $\mathrm{fbs} \le 2\,\mathrm{UC}_{\min}-1$, both point the other way.

Upper bounds — holds for every partial

  • \(\mathrm{UC}_{\min}(f) \le \mathrm{UC}(f)\)
    BHT17
    $\mathrm{UC}_{\min} = \min\{\mathrm{UC}^0,\mathrm{UC}^1\}$ and $\mathrm{UC} = \max\{\mathrm{UC}^0,\mathrm{UC}^1\}$ [BHT17, Sec. 2.5]: the cheaper side is at most the dearer one. As with $\mathrm{C}^0$, this is the line that gives the row an upper bound of any kind -- the other recorded $\mathrm{UC}_{\min}$ facts, $\mathrm{D} \le \mathrm{UC}_{\min}^2$ and $\mathrm{fbs} \le 2\,\mathrm{UC}_{\min}-1$, both point the other way.
see also: \(\mathrm{UC}_{\min}(f)\), \(\mathrm{UC}(f)\), \(\mathrm{C}(f)\), \(\mathrm{D}(f)\), \(\mathrm{fbs}(f)\) data/relations/10-new-measures.yaml

facts: $\mathrm{D}(f) \le \mathrm{UC}_{\min}(f)^2$ and $\mathrm{C}(f) \le \mathrm{UC}_{\min}(f)^2$ [BHT17, Sec. 2.7.2]; the communication-complexity analogue is due to Yannakakis and the query-side proof to Goos.

$\mathrm{fbs}(f) \le 2\,\mathrm{UC}_{\min}(f) - 1$ [BHT17, Thm 9], and the factor $2$ cannot be removed. This is exactly why the unambiguous-certificate route cannot produce a super-quadratic $\mathrm{bs}$-vs-$\mathrm{s}$ separation.

lo.note:
A single character has sparsity $1$ and $\mathrm{osss} = 1$: the two agree, but neither
grows, so this witnesses no exponent. No function in the zoo has $\mathrm{osss}$ growing
while $\mathrm{spar}$ stays bounded -- indeed $\mathrm{spar}(f) = O(1)$ forces $f$ to be a
constant-size combination of characters, and $\mathrm{osss}$ is then bounded too.
